title: MoNe: Modular Neural Memory for Efficient Long Context Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.17616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present MoNe, a lightweight modular neural memory that attaches to any frozen pretrained Transformer to enable long-context inference without retraining. MoNe reads context in fixed-size segments via test-time learning of fast-weight neural memory networks with layer-localized gradient updates; at inference, the memory generates keys and values from the query tokens alone, with no context tokens re-read. This two-phase design decouples inference cost from context length, achieving $O(N)$ preprocessing and $O(1)$ query cost with peak GPU memory that does not grow with $N$. At 128K tokens, MoNe reduces both compute and peak GPU memory by approximately 80% compared to ICL with only 6.4% parameter overhead. MoNe generalizes to context lengths far beyond the backbone's native window, achieving strong performance on needle-in-a-haystack and word extraction benchmarks from RULER, where ICL degrades sharply.

translated_title: MoNe：用于高效长上下文推理的模块化神经记忆
translated_abstract: 我们提出了MoNe，一种轻量级的模块化神经记忆，可附加到任何冻结的预训练Transformer上，无需重新训练即可实现长上下文推理。MoNe通过测试时学习快速权重神经记忆网络，并采用层局部梯度更新，以固定大小的段读取上下文；在推理时，记忆仅从查询令牌生成键和值，无需重新读取上下文令牌。这种两阶段设计将推理成本与上下文长度解耦，实现了O(N)预处理和O(1)查询成本，峰值GPU内存不随N增长。在128K令牌下，与ICL相比，MoNe将计算和峰值GPU内存均减少约80%，仅增加6.4%的参数开销。MoNe能泛化到远超骨干网络原生窗口的上下文长度，在RULER的针在干草堆和单词提取基准上表现强劲，而ICL在这些任务中性能急剧下降。
tldr: MoNe通过测试时学习的模块化神经记忆，实现了与上下文长度解耦的O(1)推理成本，在128K令牌下减少约80%的计算和内存开销，并支持远超原生窗口的上下文长度。
en_tdlr: MoNe achieves O(1) inference cost decoupled from context length via test-time learned modular neural memory, reducing compute and peak GPU memory by ~80% at 128K tokens while generalizing to far longer contexts.
